mapper.sql: select ow.id, ow.user_id, ow.amount, ow.withdrawal_type, ow.status, ow.create_time, ow.remarks, ow.transaction_type, ow.order_number, ow.is_hidden, ow.fee, ow.withdrawal_account_id, ow.request_id, ow.net_amount, ow.account_snapshot_enc, ow.account_mask, ow.business_date, ow.update_by, ow.update_time, ou.username as username, ou.phone_number as phone_number, ou.balance as user_balance, ou.frozen_balance as user_frozen_balance, pu.username as parent_username, ou.is_fake as is_fake, -- withdrawal account fields with gwa_ prefix for nested mapping gwa.id as gwa_id, gwa.user_id as gwa_user_id, gwa.type as gwa_type, gwa.withdrawal_type_id as gwa_withdrawal_type_id, gwa.is_default as gwa_is_default, gwa.bank_name as gwa_bank_name, gwa.deposit_type as gwa_deposit_type, gwa.branch_code as gwa_branch_code, gwa.branch_name as gwa_branch_name, COALESCE(gwa.bank_account_mask, CASE WHEN gwa.bank_account IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CONCAT('****', RIGHT(REPLACE(gwa.bank_account, ' ', ''), 4)) END) as gwa_bank_account, COALESCE(gwa.account_holder_mask, CASE WHEN gwa.account_holder IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CONCAT(LEFT(gwa.account_holder, 1), '***') END) as gwa_account_holder, COALESCE(gwa.account_name_mask, CASE WHEN gwa.account_name IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CONCAT(LEFT(gwa.account_name, 1), '***') END) as gwa_account_name, gwa.wallet_name as gwa_wallet_name, COALESCE(gwa.wallet_address_mask, CASE WHEN gwa.wallet_address IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(gwa.wallet_address) <= 10 THEN CONCAT('****', RIGHT(gwa.wallet_address, 4)) ELSE CONCAT(LEFT(gwa.wallet_address, 6), '****', RIGHT(gwa.wallet_address, 4)) END) as gwa_wallet_address, gwa.bank_account_enc as gwa_bank_account_enc, gwa.account_holder_enc as gwa_account_holder_enc, gwa.account_name_enc as gwa_account_name_enc, gwa.wallet_address_enc as gwa_wallet_address_enc, gwa.bank_account_mask as gwa_bank_account_mask, gwa.account_holder_mask as gwa_account_holder_mask, gwa.account_name_mask as gwa_account_name_mask, gwa.wallet_address_mask as gwa_wallet_address_mask, gwa.attachment as gwa_attachment, owt.name as gwa_withdrawal_type, gwa.create_time as gwa_create_time from order_withdrawal ow left join order_user ou on ow.user_id = ou.id left join order_user pu on ou.parent_id = pu.id left join goods_withdrawal_account gwa on ow.withdrawal_account_id = gwa.id left join order_withdrawal_type owt on gwa.withdrawal_type_id = owt.id

insert into order_withdrawal
user_id, amount, withdrawal_type, status, create_time, remarks, transaction_type, order_number, is_hidden, fee, withdrawal_account_id, request_id, net_amount, account_snapshot_enc, account_mask, business_date, update_by, update_time,
#{userId}, #{amount}, #{withdrawalType}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{remarks}, #{transactionType}, #{orderNumber}, #{isHidden}, #{fee}, #{withdrawalAccountId}, #{requestId}, #{netAmount}, #{accountSnapshotEncrypted}, #{accountMask}, #{businessDate}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime},
mapper.update: update order_withdrawal set account_snapshot_enc = #{accountSnapshotEncrypted}, account_mask = #{accountMask}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now(3) where id = #{id}

mapper.select: select id, user_id, amount, withdrawal_type, status, create_time, remarks, transaction_type, order_number, is_hidden, fee, withdrawal_account_id, request_id, net_amount, account_snapshot_enc, account_mask, business_date from order_withdrawal where id = #{id} for update
select exists(select 1 from order_withdrawal where user_id = #{userId} and status = '1')
select exists(select 1 from order_withdrawal where withdrawal_account_id = #{accountId} and status = '1')

select count(1) as withdrawalCount, COALESCE(sum(amount), 0) as withdrawalAmount from order_withdrawal where user_id = #{userId} and status in ('1', '2') and create_time >= #{start} and create_time < #{end}
mapper.update: update order_withdrawal set status = #{toStatus}, remarks = #{remarks}, update_by = COALESCE(NULLIF(#{updateBy}, ''), 'system'), update_time = now(3) where id = #{id} and status = #{fromStatus}
mapper.insert: insert into withdrawal_daily_quota (business_date, reserved_amount, update_time) values ( #{businessDate}, ( select COALESCE(sum(amount), 0) from order_withdrawal where status in ('1', '2') and (business_date = #{businessDate} or (business_date is null and create_time >= #{legacyStart} and create_time < #{legacyEnd})) ), NOW(3) ) on duplicate key update business_date = values(business_date)
mapper.update: update withdrawal_daily_quota set reserved_amount = reserved_amount + #{amount}, update_time = NOW(3) where business_date = #{businessDate} and (#{limit} is null or #{limit} <= 0 or reserved_amount + #{amount} <= #{limit})
mapper.select: select id, user_id, amount, withdrawal_type, status, create_time, remarks, transaction_type, order_number, is_hidden, fee, withdrawal_account_id, request_id, net_amount, account_snapshot_enc, account_mask, business_date from order_withdrawal where user_id = #{userId} and COALESCE(is_hidden, '1') != '0' and status = #{status} order by create_time desc, id desc
